properties.statement: Measured 2026-10-30 ~15:20Z for option C. (1) The gateway deployed on flo2.io (/srv/flo2/gateway/src/engine-tools.ts, ENGINE_CATALOG_VERSION 0.94.0) lists record_the_build; flo2 main's catalog (0.95.0) does too. The chat door refuses only its `files` argument (CHAT_REFUSED_ARGUMENTS); the rest is served at both doors. (2) In the session that read the hub's tool list for step 7 (claude.ai/code session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P, connected before 0.92.0 added the tool), the hub's deferred tool list has no record_the_build, and the hub answers a schema miss with 'your client's tool list may predate this server (0.94.0). Reconnect'. Not established: what a freshly connected client is listed (not measured from a new connection), and whether a stale client list is why record_the_build was never called (a candidate only: most counted calls come from long-running sessions of this one person's agents).
